queries:
WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_difference,
    AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanprocessing AS p ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
)
SELECT
  zoneregistry,
  insurstat,
  avg_cpu_gpu_difference,
  avg_remaining_gb / (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) FROM site_averages) AS relative_remaining_gb
FROM site_averages

SELECT
    s.zonelabel,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(p.procgpu - p.proccpu) AS avg_gpu_cpu_difference,
    AVG(p.remaingb * 1.0 / NULLIF(p.memusagegb, 0)) AS storage_ratio
FROM sites AS s
JOIN scanprocessing AS p
    ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel, s.insurstat

SELECT
    s.zonelabel,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_difference,
    SUM(p.remaingb) / NULLIF(SUM(p.memusagegb), 0) AS storage_ratio
FROM sites AS s
JOIN scanprocessing AS p ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat

SELECT
    s.zonelabel,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(p.proccpu) - AVG(p.procgpu) AS cpu_gpu_difference,
    AVG(p.remaingb) / NULLIF(AVG(p.memusagegb), 0) AS storage_ratio
FROM sites AS s
JOIN scanprocessing AS p
    ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat

SELECT
    s.zonelabel,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(p.procgpu) - AVG(p.proccpu) AS avg_gpu_minus_cpu,
    AVG(p.remaingb) / NULLIF(AVG(p.memusagegb), 0) AS storage_ratio
FROM sites AS s
JOIN scanprocessing AS p
    ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat

SELECT
    s.zonelabel,
    s.insurstat,
    ABS(AVG(p.proccpu) - AVG(p.procgpu)) AS usage_difference,
    AVG(p.remaingb) / NULLIF(AVG(p.memusagegb), 0) AS storage_ratio
FROM sites AS s
JOIN scanprocessing AS p
    ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
